newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total starts Venezuela field production.
newsitem.headline: Total starts Venezuela field production.

text.p: French oil company Total said on Tuesday it and Amoco have started production on the Venezuela Deep Jusepin field, with a flow rate of 10,000 barrels per day of oil and around 700,000 cubic metres per day of natural gas.

Production began one year after exploratory drilling, Total said in a statement. Output should plateau at 30,000 bpd by the end of 1997 once permanent production facilities have been installed and a second well, currently being drilled, comes on stream. Total is operator on the field with a 55 percent stake. Amoco holds 45 percent.
A second discovery made on a neighbouring structure in September 1996 should enter production in the beginning of 1998.
Total has performed successful water-flooding tests in the shallower horizons of the Jusepin field, allowing the recovery of additional quantities of oil.
